SELECT (p.issue_quantity - COALESCE(s.total_used, 0)) AS total_available, (p.limit_quantity - COALESCE(u.user_used, 0)) AS available,

p.is_deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.give_type = 0 and p.recycle_activity = 0 and p.discount != 10
